examples.english: Professor Li from the History Department has recently often been interviewed by reporters, and therefore has become very famous. That reporter, in order to interview the president about questions on diplomacy, trade, and other aspects, read a lot of related materials.

examples.chinese: 從六○年代開始，臺灣就提供農業方面的協助給許多國家，這點讓我覺得很驕傲。
examples.pinyin: Cóng liù○ niándài kāishǐ, Táiwān jiù tígōng nóngyè fāngmiàn de xiézhù gěi xǔduō guójiā, zhè diǎn ràng wǒ juéde hěn jiāo'ào.
examples.english: Starting from the 1960s, Taiwan has provided assistance in agriculture to many countries; this point makes me feel very proud.

examples.chinese: 最近天氣不太穩定，氣溫的變化很大，出門時最好帶把傘。
examples.pinyin: Zuìjìn tiānqì bú tài wěndìng, qìwēn de biànhuà hěn dà, chūmén shí zuìhǎo dài bǎ sǎn.
examples.english: The weather has been unstable recently, and the temperature changes a lot; when going out, it's best to bring an umbrella.

examples.chinese: 科學家發明了電燈，改變了人類的生活方式，也大大提高了生活品質。網路是很偉大的發明，就算不出門，也能讓人們得到全球各地的訊息。
examples.pinyin: Kēxuéjiā fāmíng le diàndēng, gǎibiàn le rénlèi de shēnghuó fāngshì, yě dàdà tígāo le shēnghuó pǐnzhí. Wǎnglù shì hěn wěidà de fāmíng, jiùsuàn bù chūmén, yě néng ràng rénmen dédào quánqiú gèdì de xùnxí.
examples.english: Scientists invented the electric light, which changed the lifestyle of mankind and also greatly improved the quality of life. The Internet is a great invention; even without going out, it can let people get information from all over the world.

examples.chinese: 王伯伯最近很得意，到處告訴鄰居他兒子考上了全國最有名的大學。
examples.pinyin: Wáng bóbo zuìjìn hěn déyì, dàochù gàosù línjū tā érzi kǎo shàng le quánguó zuì yǒumíng de dàxué.
examples.english: Uncle Wang has been very proud of himself recently, telling neighbors everywhere that his son has been admitted to the most famous university in the country.

examples.chinese: 王先生投資生意的眼光很好，讓他僅僅一年就買下了好幾棟大樓。
examples.pinyin: Wáng xiānshēng tóuzī shēngyì de yǎnguāng hěn hǎo, ràng tā jǐnjǐn yī nián jiù mǎi xià le hǎo jǐ dòng dàlóu.
examples.english: Mr. Wang's eye for investing in business is very good; it made him buy several buildings in just one year.

examples.chinese: 儘管這次推銷新產品的活動辦得很順利，顧客的反應也很好，不過還是有需要改進的地方。
examples.pinyin: Jǐnguǎn zhè cì tuīxiāo xīn chǎnpǐn de huódòng bàn de hěn shùnlì, gùkè de fǎnyìng yě hěn hǎo, bùguò háishì yǒu xūyào gǎijìn de dìfāng.
examples.english: Although this event to promote the new product went very smoothly and customers' reactions were also very good, there are still areas that need improvement.

examples.chinese: 由於雲端科技的進步，人類的生活方式跟以往比起來有很大的差異。
examples.pinyin: Yóuyú yúnduān kējì de jìnbù, rénlèi de shēnghuó fāngshì gēn yǐwǎng bǐ qǐlái yǒu hěn dà de chāyì.
examples.english: Owing to advances in cloud technology, humans' way of life has great differences compared to the past.

examples.chinese: 夏天時，在臺灣、日本、菲律賓都有颱風，這是很普遍的現象。
examples.pinyin: Xiàtiān shí, zài Táiwān, Rìběn, Fēilǜbīn dōu yǒu táifēng, zhè shì hěn pǔbiàn de xiànxiàng.
examples.english: In summer, there are typhoons in Taiwan, Japan, and the Philippines; this is a very common phenomenon.

examples.chinese: 這兩家公司在科技方面合作了很多年，也在科學雜誌上發表了共同的研究成果。
examples.pinyin: Zhè liǎng jiā gōngsī zài kējì fāngmiàn hézuò le hěn duō nián, yě zài kēxué zázhì shàng fābiǎo le gòngtóng de yánjiū chéngguǒ.
examples.english: These two companies have cooperated in technology for many years and have also published mutual research results in science magazines.

examples.chinese: 大家都知道喝太多酒對身體沒有好處，但不少人仍然如此，甚至天天喝醉。淡水的夕陽很美，如此的美麗風景，是約會的極佳地點。
examples.pinyin: Dàjiā dōu zhīdào hē tài duō jiǔ duì shēntǐ méiyǒu hǎochù, dàn bùshǎo rén réngrán rúcǐ, shènzhì tiāntiān hē zuì. Dànshuǐ de xīyáng hěn měi, rúcǐ de měilì fēngjǐng, shì yuēhuì de jíjiā dìdiǎn.
examples.english: Everyone knows that drinking too much alcohol is not good for the body, but many people still do so, and even get drunk every day. The sunset in Tamsui is very beautiful; such a beautiful scenery is an excellent place for a date.

examples.chinese: 很可愛，友美喜歡可愛的東西。
examples.pinyin: Hěn kěài. Yǒuměi xǐhuān kěài de dōngxi.
examples.english: It’s very cute. Youmei likes cute stuff.

examples.chinese: 五十塊錢很便宜！妳看，哪個顏色漂亮？
examples.pinyin: Wǔshí kuài qián hěn piányí! Nǐ kàn, nǎ ge yánsè piàoliang?
examples.english: It is inexpensive! Look, which color is better?

examples.chinese: 咖啡、茶，我都喜歡。我也很餓，想吃一點兒東西。
examples.pinyin: Kāfēi, chá, wǒ dōu xǐhuān. Wǒ yě hěn è, xiǎng chī yìdiǎnr dōngxi.
examples.english: Coffee and tea, I like them both. I am also hungry; I would like to have some food.

examples.chinese: 這家餐廳人太多，我們去那家餐廳，好嗎？他們的牛肉麵很好吃，也很便宜。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng rén tài duō. Wǒmen qù nà jiā cāntīng, hǎo ma? Tāmen de niúròu miàn hěn hǎochī, yě hěn piányi.
examples.english: There are too many people in this restaurant. How about that restaurant? They have delicious beef noodles, and it is also cheap.

examples.chinese: 他們賣很多種飲料。
examples.pinyin: Tāmen mài hěn duō zhǒng yǐnliào.
examples.english: They have various kinds of drink.

examples.chinese: 我知道一家很不錯的咖啡廳，那裡的冰淇淋很好吃。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zhīdào yì jiā hěn búcuò de kāfēitīng, nàlǐ de bīngqílín hěn hǎochī.
examples.english: I know a nice café. They serve delicious ice cream.

examples.chinese: 有啊！他們有很多種冰淇淋。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu a! Tāmen yǒu hěn duō zhǒng bīngqílín.
examples.english: Oh, yeah. They have lots of kinds of ice cream.

examples.chinese: 我很忙，現在要去廚房做飯，你再去房間找吧。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hěn máng, xiànzài yào qù chúfáng zuòfàn, nǐ zài qù fángjiān zhǎo ba.
examples.english: I am very busy and I am going to the kitchen to cook now. You go check your room again.

examples.chinese: 今天天氣不錯，海邊的風景也很漂亮，我想去游泳，妳們想去嗎？
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān tiānqì búcuò, hǎibiān de fēngjǐng yě hěn piàoliàng, wǒ xiǎng qù yóuyǒng, nǐmen xiǎng qù ma?
examples.english: The weather is pretty good today, so is the view at the beach. I want to go swimming. Do you want to go?

examples.chinese: 我不喜歡跑步，我跑步跑得很慢。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bù xǐhuān pǎobù, wǒ pǎobù pǎo de hěn màn.
examples.english: I do not like to run; I run slowly.

examples.chinese: 打網球怎麼樣？中明說妳的網球打得很好，我們一起去打吧。
examples.pinyin: Dǎ wǎngqiú zěnmeyàng? Zhōngmíng shuō nǐ de wǎngqiú dǎ de hěn hǎo, wǒmen yìqǐ qù dǎ ba.
examples.english: How about playing tennis? Zhongming said you play it well. Let’s go play it together.

examples.chinese: 聽說這部電影很有趣，我們晚一起去看，好不好？
examples.pinyin: Tīngshuō zhè bù diànyǐng hěn yǒuqù. Wǒmen wǎnshang yìqǐ qù kàn, hǎo bù hǎo?
examples.english: I heard that this movie is very interesting. How about we go to see it tonight?

examples.chinese: 機場附近的風景也很漂亮，我常常去看風景、看飛機。
examples.pinyin: Jīchǎng fùjìn de fēngjǐng yě hěn piàoliang, wǒ chángcháng qù kàn fēngjǐng, kàn fēijī.
examples.english: The scenery near the airport is beautiful; I often go there to see the view and watch the planes.

examples.chinese: 元真，妳的這條裙子真好看，我很喜歡。
examples.pinyin: Yuánzhēn, nǐ de zhè tiáo qúnzi zhēn hǎokàn, wǒ hěn xǐhuān.
examples.english: Yuanzhen, your skirt is very beautiful; I like it very much.

examples.chinese: 聽說這個牌子的東西很貴，可是很多人喜歡。
examples.pinyin: Tīngshuō zhè ge páizi de dōngxi hěn guì, kěshì hěn duō rén xǐhuān.
examples.english: I heard that this clothing brand is very expensive, but a lot of people like it.

examples.chinese: 是啊，因為這個牌子很有名，衣服、褲子和裙子也都很好看，所以很多人買。
examples.pinyin: Shì a, yīnwèi zhè ge páizi hěn yǒumíng, yīfu, kùzi hé qúnzi yě dōu hěn hǎokàn, suǒyǐ hěn duō rén mǎi.
examples.english: Yes, it is. This brand is very famous and its tops, pants and skirts are very beautiful, so many people buy it.

examples.chinese: 我很想去看，可是我最近胖了五公斤，我怕衣服不好買。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hěn xiǎng qù kàn, kěshì wǒ zuìjìn pàng le wǔ gōngjīn, wǒ pà yīfu bù hǎo mǎi.
examples.english: I would like to check it out. But I have recently gained 5 kilograms, so I am worried that they don’t have my size.

examples.chinese: 很好看。這條藍的也很漂亮，藍色是今年很流行的顏色。
examples.pinyin: Hěn hǎokàn. Zhè tiáo lán de yě hěn piàoliang, lánsè shì jīnnián hěn liúxíng de yánsè.
examples.english: It is. This pair of blue pants is beautiful too. Blue is a popular color of this year.

examples.chinese: 百貨公司裡有很多衣服、鞋子和皮包，都是最新的，所以很多年輕女生喜歡到百貨公司去，漂亮的、流行的衣服，她們都想穿穿看。
examples.pinyin: Bǎihuògōngsī lǐ yǒu hěn duō yīfu, xiézi hé píbāo, dōu shì zuì xīn de, suǒyǐ hěn duō niánqīng nǚshēng xǐhuān dào bǎihuògōngsī qù, piàoliang de, liúxíng de yīfu, tāmen dōu xiǎng chuānchuān kàn.
examples.english: Clothes, shoes and purses in department stores are all the latest; therefore, many young ladies like to go there and try on both beautiful and trendy items.

examples.chinese: 很多年輕男生愛在書店看汽車雜誌，汽車很貴，他們不一定可以買新車，可是都看得很開心。
examples.pinyin: Hěn duō niánqīng nánshēng ài zài shūdiàn kàn qìchē zázhì, qìchē hěn guì, tāmen bù yídìng kěyǐ mǎi xīn chē, kěshì dōu kàn de hěn kāixīn.
examples.english: Many young men like to read car magazines at bookstores. Cars are expensive and they don’t usually have the money to buy new ones; however, they are very happy just by reading those magazines.

examples.chinese: 我覺得有的舊東西很不錯，有的新東西也很有趣，我很喜歡看新車、新衣服，可是因為我的錢不多，所以我不常買。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ juéde yǒude jiù dōngxi hěn búcuò, yǒude xīn dōngxi yě hěn yǒuqù, wǒ hěn xǐhuān kàn xīn chē, xīn yīfu, kěshì yīnwèi wǒ de qián bù duō, suǒyǐ wǒ bù cháng mǎi.
examples.english: I think some old stuff is good and some new ones are interesting. I like to check the new car, new clothes out, but I do not have much money, so I don’t buy them often.

examples.chinese: 太好了！在那裡看書很舒服。我們每天都能用那間教室嗎？
examples.pinyin: Tài hǎo le! Zài nàlǐ kànshū hěn shūfu. Wǒmen měi tiān dōu néng yòng nà jiān jiàoshì ma?
examples.english: That’s awesome! Studying there is very comfortable. Can we use it every day?

examples.chinese: 現在我非常忙，沒有很多時間讀書，可是因為有語言交換，所以我的中文進步了。
examples.pinyin: Xiànzài wǒ fēicháng máng, méi yǒu hěn duō shíjiān dúshū, kěshì yīnwèi yǒu yǔyán jiāohuàn, suǒyǐ wǒ de Zhōngwén jìnbù le.
examples.english: Nowadays, I am very busy; I don’t have much time for studying. However, because of language exchange, I have improved (my Chinese) a lot.

examples.chinese: 下個星期華語課有期中考，我有一點兒緊張，所以每天晚上都讀書，也練習寫字，希望下個星期的考試能考得很好。
examples.pinyin: Xià ge xīngqí Huáyǔ kè yǒu qízhōngkǎo, wǒ yǒu yìdiǎnr jǐnzhāng, suǒyǐ měi tiān wǎnshang dōu dúshū, yě liànxí xiězì, xīwàng xià ge xīngqí de kǎoshì néng kǎo de hěn hǎo.
examples.english: I will have the midterm exam for Chinese class next week. I am a bit nervous so I study every night and practice writing Chinese characters as well. I hope I can do well on the exam next week.

examples.chinese: 最近很多人感冒，你們要戴口罩，也要常常洗手。
examples.pinyin: Zuìjìn hěn duō rén gǎnmào, nǐmen yào dài kǒuzhào, yě yào chángcháng xǐshǒu.
examples.english: Many people got sick lately. You need to wear a surgical mask and wash your hands often.

examples.chinese: 老師，我很健康，不常生病。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī, wǒ hěn jiànkāng, bù cháng shēngbìng.
examples.english: I am healthy and seldom get sick, teacher.

examples.chinese: 最近天氣冷了，很多人感冒了。
examples.pinyin: Zuìjìn tiānqì lěng le, hěn duō rén gǎnmào le.
examples.english: The weather is getting cold recently, many people got colds.

examples.chinese: 對啊！聽說我們學校感冒、發燒的學生很多。
examples.pinyin: Duì a! Tīngshuō wǒmen xuéxiào gǎnmào, fāshāo de xuéshēng hěn duō.
examples.english: Right! I heard that many students from my school have a cold and fever.

examples.chinese: 最近也有很多人肚子痛。
examples.pinyin: Zuìjìn yě yǒu hěn duō rén dùzi tòng.
examples.english: Many people have a stomachache as well.

examples.chinese: 最近感冒的人很多，我的同學國安也感冒了，今天開始發燒了。
examples.pinyin: Zuìjìn gǎnmào de rén hěn duō, wǒ de tóngxué Guó'ān yě gǎnmào le, jīntiān kāishǐ fāshāo le.
examples.english: Many people got colds lately. My classmate, Guoan, got a cold, too. He started to have a fever today.

examples.chinese: 我很擔心他，請他去看醫生，也告訴他要聽醫生的話，不要忘記多喝水、多休息。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hěn dānxīn tā, qǐng tā qù kàn yīshēng, yě gàosu tā yào tīng yīshēng de huà, bú yào wàngjì duō hē shuǐ, duō xiūxí.
examples.english: I’m so worried about him, so I told him to go see a doctor. I also told him to listen to the doctor, to drink plenty of water and get some rest.

examples.chinese: 我們下個星期要學第十五課，我剛才先看了一點兒，書上有很多種動物，我覺得很有意思。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen xià ge xīngqí yào xué dì shíwǔ kè, wǒ gāngcái xiān kàn le yìdiǎnr, shū shàng yǒu hěn duō zhǒng dòngwù, wǒ juéde hěn yǒuyìsi.
examples.english: We are going to learn lesson fifteen next week. I previewed a bit earlier just now. There are many kinds of animals in the book; I think it is very interesting.

examples.chinese: 原來是十二生肖，真的很有意思。
examples.pinyin: Yuánlái shì shí'èr shēngxiào, zhēnde hěn yǒuyìsi.
examples.english: Oh! You are talking about the Chinese animal zodiac! It’s really interesting.

examples.chinese: 很簡單，上網一查就知道了。
examples.pinyin: Hěn jiǎndān, shàngwǎng yì chá jiù zhīdào le.
examples.english: It’s very simple. You can know it as soon as you check it online.

examples.chinese: 我去年去看了，很多大人帶著小孩去看燈會，非常熱鬧，我照了很多相片。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ qùnián qù kàn le, hěn duō dàrén dài zhe xiǎohái qù kàn dēnghuì, fēicháng rènào, wǒ zhào le hěn duō xiàngpiàn.
examples.english: Last year I went to see the Carnival. Many adults brought their children to see the Lantern Carnival, and it was very lively. I took a lot of photos.

examples.english: This kind of beverage tastes good.

examples.chinese: 你很渴嗎？我有一瓶飲料，你要不要喝？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ hěn kě ma? Wǒ yǒu yì píng yǐnliào, nǐ yào bú yào hē?
examples.english: Are you thirsty? I have a bottle of beverage, would you like to have some?

examples.chinese: 我的女朋友很喜歡喝珍珠奶茶。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de nǚ péngyǒu hěn xǐhuān hē zhēnzhū nǎichá.
examples.english: My girlfriend likes bubble milk tea very much.

examples.chinese: 台灣夏天的天氣很熱，很多人都喜歡喝飲料。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān xiàtiān de tiānqì hěn rè, hěn duō rén dōu xǐhuān hē yǐnliào.
examples.english: During summer the weather is very hot in Taiwan, many people like to have beverages.

examples.chinese: 我爸爸每天早上都喝一杯咖啡。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bàba měi tiān zǎoshang dōu hē yì bēi kāfēi.
examples.english: My father drinks a cup of coffee every morning.

examples.chinese: 那家飲料店的飲料很好喝，我們去那裡買。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā yǐnliào diàn de yǐnliào hěn hǎohē, wǒmen qù nàlǐ mǎi.
examples.english: That beverage store serves great beverages. Let’s go there and get some.

examples.chinese: 爸爸在客廳喝咖啡。
examples.pinyin: Bàba zài kètīng hē kāfēi.
examples.english: Dad is drinking coffee in the living room.

examples.chinese: 我朋友說這家餐廳的咖啡很好喝。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ péngyǒu shuō zhè jiā cāntīng de kāfēi hěn hǎohē.
examples.english: My friend said this restaurant’s coffee is good.

examples.chinese: 我平常喜歡喝茶，有（的）時候喝一點兒咖啡。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ píngcháng xǐhuān hē chá, yǒu (de) shíhou hē yìdiǎnr kāfēi.
examples.english: I usually like drinking tea. Sometimes I drink a little coffee.

examples.chinese: 我平常喜歡喝茶，有(的)時候喝一點兒咖啡。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ píngcháng xǐhuān hē chá, yǒu(de) shíhou hē yìdiǎnr kāfēi.
examples.english: I usually like to drink tea; sometimes I drink a little coffee.

examples.chinese: 他很喜歡喝茶，我想你可以送他一些台灣茶。
examples.pinyin: Tā hěn xǐhuān hē chá, wǒ xiǎng nǐ kěyǐ sòng tā yīxiē Táiwān chá.
examples.english: He really likes drinking tea; I think you can give him some Taiwan tea.

examples.chinese: 我只想喝茶，別的飲料我都不想喝。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zhǐ xiǎng hē chá, bié de yǐnliào wǒ dōu bù xiǎng hē.
examples.english: I only want to drink tea; I don't want to drink any other beverages.

examples.chinese: 她明天也許有空，我們可以請她一起來喝咖啡。
examples.pinyin: Tā míngtiān yěxǔ yǒu kòng, wǒmen kěyǐ qǐng tā yìqǐ lái hē kāfēi.
examples.english: She might be free tomorrow; we can invite her to come have coffee together.

examples.chinese: 醫生說，我應該多喝水，不需要吃藥。
examples.pinyin: Yīshēng shuō, wǒ yīnggāi duō hē shuǐ, bù xūyào chī yào.
examples.english: The doctor said I should drink more water and don't need to take medicine.

examples.chinese: 這個孩子還太小，不能喝酒。
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge háizi hái tài xiǎo, bù néng hē jiǔ.
examples.english: This child is still too young, cannot drink alcohol.

examples.chinese: 天氣熱的時候，我不喜歡喝熱湯。
examples.pinyin: Tiānqì rè de shíhòu, wǒ bù xǐhuān hē rè tāng.
examples.english: When the weather is hot, I don't like to drink hot soup.

examples.chinese: 哥哥洗澡以後都先喝一瓶牛奶再睡覺。
examples.pinyin: Gēge xǐzǎo yǐhòu dōu xiān hē yì píng niúnǎi zài shuìjiào.
examples.english: After my older brother takes a shower, he always first drinks a bottle of milk and then goes to sleep.

examples.chinese: 為什麼她咖啡喝了一半就不喝了？
examples.pinyin: Wèishénme tā kāfēi hē le yíbàn jiù bù hē le?
examples.english: Why did she drink half of her coffee and then stop drinking?

examples.chinese: 哥哥只要睡前喝太多水，就會夢到半夜起床找不到廁所，這樣的夢真可怕！
examples.pinyin: Gēge zhǐyào shuì qián hē tài duō shuǐ, jiù huì mèng dào bànyè qǐchuáng zhǎo bù dào cèsuǒ, zhèyàng de mèng zhēn kěpà!
examples.english: As long as my older brother drinks too much water before bed, he dreams of getting up in the middle of the night and not being able to find the toilet; such a dream is really scary!

examples.chinese: 過年回家吃年夜飯，大家吃著吃著，就喝起酒來了，每喝幾杯，就唱一首歌，熱鬧極了。
examples.pinyin: Guònián huí jiā chī niányèfàn, dàjiā chī zhe chī zhe, jiù hē qǐ jiǔ lái le, měi hē jǐ bēi, jiù chàng yì shǒu gē, rènao jí le.
examples.english: When we go home for Chinese New Year to eat the New Year's Eve dinner, as everyone eats and eats, they start drinking; every few cups, they sing a song—it's extremely lively.

examples.chinese: 因為有人喝酒後開車，造成了嚴重的交通意外，警察和救護車都趕來了。不管出國工作或留學，一定得買個平安保險，萬一發生什麼意外才能得到幫助。
examples.pinyin: Yīnwèi yǒu rén hējiǔ hòu kāichē, zàochéng le yánzhòng de jiāotōng yìwài, jǐngchá hé jiùhùchē dōu gǎnlái le. Bùguǎn chūguó gōngzuò huò liúxué, yīdìng děi mǎi gè píng'ān bǎoxiǎn, wànyī fāshēng shénme yìwài cái néng dédào bāngzhù.
examples.english: Because someone drove after drinking, it caused a serious traffic accident; both the police and ambulance rushed over. Whether going abroad to work or study, you must buy safety insurance so that in case any accident happens, you can get help.

examples.chinese: 夏天的夜晚，人們喜歡在屋子外面吹著風、喝著茶，聊聊有趣的事。
examples.pinyin: Xiàtiān de yèwǎn, rénmen xǐhuān zài wūzi wàimiàn chuī zhe fēng, hē zhe chá, liáoliao yǒuqù de shì.
examples.english: On summer nights, people like to be outside the house, feeling the breeze, drinking tea, and chatting about interesting things.

examples.chinese: 小白喝了太多酒，已經醉了，不能讓他繼續喝了。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Bái hē le tài duō jiǔ, yǐjīng zuì le, bùnéng ràng tā jìxù hē le.
examples.english: Xiao Bai has drunk too much alcohol and is already drunk; we can't let him keep drinking.

examples.chinese: 張先生以為喝醉了就能把痛苦忘掉，沒想到越喝越痛苦。
examples.pinyin: Zhāng xiānsheng yǐwéi hē zuì le jiù néng bǎ tòngkǔ wàng diào, méi xiǎngdào yuè hē yuè tòngkǔ.
examples.english: Mr. Zhang thought that getting drunk would let him forget his pain, but unexpectedly, the more he drank, the more painful he felt.

examples.chinese: 秋天的天氣變化很大，早晚都有點涼，出門時最好帶件外套。 這碗魚湯要趁熱喝，涼了就不好喝了。
examples.pinyin: Qiūtiān de tiānqì biànhuà hěn dà, zǎowǎn dōu yǒudiǎn liáng, chūmén shí zuìhǎo dài jiàn wàitào. Zhè wǎn yútāng yào chèn rè hē, liáng le jiù bù hǎohē le.
examples.english: Autumn weather changes a lot; it's a bit chilly morning and evening, so it's best to bring a jacket when going out. This bowl of fish soup should be drunk while hot; once it's cold, it won't taste good.

examples.chinese: 顏先生對吃、喝都很講究，吃牛排時應該喝什麼酒，他也很有研究。
examples.pinyin: Yán xiānsheng duì chī, hē dōu hěn jiǎngjiū, chī niúpái shí yīnggāi hē shénme jiǔ, tā yě hěn yǒu yánjiū.
examples.english: Mr. Yan is very particular about eating and drinking; he has also studied what wine should be drunk when eating steak.

examples.chinese: 一般來說，小感冒只要多喝水、多休息就行了，不需要看病、吃藥。
examples.pinyin: Yībān lái shuō, xiǎo gǎnmào zhǐyào duō hē shuǐ, duō xiūxi jiù xíng le, bù xūyào kànbìng, chī yào.
examples.english: Generally speaking, for a minor cold, you just need to drink more water and rest more; you don't need to see a doctor or take medicine.

examples.chinese: 有的人一喝牛奶就拉肚子，可能是因為身體吸收不料牛奶的營養。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu de rén yì hē niúnǎi jiù lādùzi, kěnéng shì yīnwèi shēntǐ xīshōu bù liǎo niúnǎi de yíngyǎng.
examples.english: Some people get diarrhea as soon as they drink milk; it may be because their body cannot absorb the nutrition in milk.

examples.chinese: 強烈颱風快來了，救災中心對民眾發出警告，為了自己的生命安全，絕對別去海邊。小游經常喝了酒還開車回家，太太警告他如果不改掉這個壞習慣，就要跟他離婚。
examples.pinyin: Qiángliè táifēng kuài lái le, jiùzāi zhōngxīn duì mínzhòng fāchū jǐnggào, wèile zìjǐ de shēngmìng ānquán, juéduì bié qù hǎibiān. Xiǎo Yóu jīngcháng hē le jiǔ hái kāichē huí jiā, tàitai jǐnggào tā rúguǒ bù gǎidiào zhège huài xíguàn, jiù yào gēn tā líhūn.
examples.english: A strong typhoon is coming soon; the disaster relief center issued a warning to the public: for your own safety, absolutely do not go to the beach. Xiao You often drives home after drinking; his wife warned him that if he doesn't change this bad habit, she will divorce him.

examples.chinese: 醫生一再警告韓先生絕對不能再喝酒了，要不然他的身體情況就會更糟了。
examples.pinyin: Yīshēng yízài jǐnggào Hán xiānsheng juéduì bù néng zài hējiǔ le, yàobùrán tā de shēntǐ qíngkuàng jiù huì gèng zāo le.
examples.english: The doctor repeatedly warned Mr. Han that he absolutely must not drink alcohol anymore; otherwise his physical condition would get worse.

examples.chinese: 那個人喝了酒還開車，結果造成嚴重的車禍，害兩個人不幸死了，真可惡！
examples.pinyin: Nàge rén hē le jiǔ hái kāichē, jiéguǒ zàochéng yánzhòng de chēhuò, hài liǎng ge rén bùxìng sǐ le, zhēn kěwù!
examples.english: That person drank alcohol and still drove, resulting in a serious car accident that caused two people to die tragically; how detestable!

examples.chinese: 老婆：我叫你買豆漿，怎麼買了無糖的，真難喝！ 老公：妳又沒說清楚，怎麼能怪我。
examples.pinyin: Lǎopó: Wǒ jiào nǐ mǎi dòujiāng, zěnme mǎi le wútáng de, zhēn nánhē! Lǎogōng: Nǐ yòu méi shuō qīngchu, zěnme néng guài wǒ.
examples.english: Wife: I told you to buy soy milk; how come you bought the sugar-free kind? It tastes awful! Husband: You didn't say clearly, so how can you blame me?

examples.chinese: 太太：你喝醉了，別再喝了。 先生：好啦，好啦，還剩下一口，喝完就不喝了。
examples.pinyin: Tàitai: Nǐ hē zuì le, bié zài hē le. Xiānsheng: Hǎo la, hǎo la, hái shèngxià yī kǒu, hē wán jiù bù hē le.
examples.english: Wife: You're drunk; don't drink anymore. Husband: Okay, okay, there's still one sip left; after I finish it, I won't drink anymore.

examples.chinese: 小簡今天遇到以前的女朋友，跟她喝了咖啡才回家，但不敢跟太太說實話。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Jiǎn jīntiān yùdào yǐqián de nǚpéngyǒu, gēn tā hē le kāfēi cái huí jiā, dàn bù gǎn gēn tàitai shuō shíhuà.
examples.english: Today Xiao Jian ran into his ex-girlfriend, and only went home after having coffee with her, but he didn't dare tell his wife the truth.

examples.chinese: 根據專家的說法，想要身體健康，一天至少得喝五大杯水。
examples.pinyin: Gēnjù zhuānjiā de shuōfǎ, xiǎng yào shēntǐ jiànkāng, yì tiān zhìshǎo děi hē wǔ dà bēi shuǐ.
examples.english: According to experts, if you want to be healthy, you need to drink at least five large glasses of water a day.

examples.chinese: 連警察都證明這個車禍是段老闆喝醉造成的，可是他仍然不肯承認。
examples.pinyin: Lián jǐngchá dōu zhèngmíng zhège chēhuò shì Duàn lǎobǎn hē zuì zàochéng de, kěshì tā réngrán bù kěn chéngrèn.
examples.english: Even the police proved that this car accident was caused by Boss Duan getting drunk, but he still refuses to admit it.

examples.chinese: 大家都知道喝太多酒對身體沒有好處，但不少人仍然如此，甚至天天喝醉。淡水的夕陽很美，如此的美麗風景，是約會的極佳地點。
examples.pinyin: Dàjiā dōu zhīdào hē tài duō jiǔ duì shēntǐ méiyǒu hǎochù, dàn bùshǎo rén réngrán rúcǐ, shènzhì tiāntiān hē zuì. Dànshuǐ de xīyáng hěn měi, rúcǐ de měilì fēngjǐng, shì yuēhuì de jíjiā dìdiǎn.
examples.english: Everyone knows that drinking too much alcohol is not good for the body, but many people still do so, and even get drunk every day. The sunset in Tamsui is very beautiful; such a beautiful scenery is an excellent place for a date.

examples.chinese: 天氣好熱，我們去喝飲料，好不好？
examples.pinyin: Tiānqì hǎo rè, wǒmen qù hē yǐnliào, hǎo bù hǎo?
examples.english: The weather is so hot. How about we go have some drink?

examples.chinese: 好啊！你想喝什麼？咖啡還是茶？
examples.pinyin: Hǎo a! Nǐ xiǎng hē shénme? Kāfēi háishì chá?
examples.english: Okay! What would you like to drink? Coffee or tea?

examples.chinese: 妳星期六下午有空嗎？我們一起去喝下午茶，怎麼樣？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ xīngqí liù xiàwǔ yǒukòng ma? Wǒmen yìqǐ qù hē xiàwǔ chá, zěnmeyàng?
examples.english: Are you available on Saturday afternoon? How about we have afternoon tea together?

examples.chinese: 媽，我跟友美要去喝下午茶，可是我的錢包不在房間裡。
examples.pinyin: Mā, wǒ gēn Yǒuměi yào qù hē xiàwǔ chá, kěshì wǒ de qiánbāo bú zài fángjiān lǐ.
examples.english: Mom, Youmei and I are going to have afternoon tea now, but my wallet is not in the bedroom.

examples.chinese: 妳可以帶一些水果去看國安，跟他說應該多喝水，也要多休息。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ kěyǐ dài yìxiē shuǐguǒ qù kàn Guó'ān, gēn tā shuō yīnggāi duō hē shuǐ, yě yào duō xiūxí.
examples.english: You can take some fruit to visit Guoan. Tell him to drink plenty of water and get much rest as well.

examples.chinese: 我會給你三天的藥。你要記得多喝一點兒水，要是發燒了，就吃紅色的藥。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ huì gěi nǐ sān tiān de yào. Nǐ yào jìde duō hē yìdiǎnr shuǐ, yàoshi fāshāo le, jiù chī hóngsè de yào.
examples.english: I will give you medicine for 3 days. Remember to drink plenty of water. If you have a fever, then take the red pill.

examples.chinese: 我很擔心他，請他去看醫生，也告訴他要聽醫生的話，不要忘記多喝水、多休息。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hěn dānxīn tā, qǐng tā qù kàn yīshēng, yě gàosu tā yào tīng yīshēng de huà, bú yào wàngjì duō hē shuǐ, duō xiūxí.
examples.english: I’m so worried about him, so I told him to go see a doctor. I also told him to listen to the doctor, to drink plenty of water and get some rest.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ jǐ diǎn qù xuéxiào?
examples.english: What time do you go to school?

examples.english: I go to school at 8:10.

examples.pinyin: Jīntiān shì xīngqí yī, nǐ bú qù xuéxiào ma?
examples.english: It is Monday today; aren’t you going to school?

examples.pinyin: Tā jīntiān bù lái xuéxiào ma?
examples.english: Isn’t he coming to school today?

examples.chinese: 他在學校，不在家。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài xuéxiào, bú zài jiā.
examples.english: He is at school, not at home.

examples.chinese: 他在學校，不在家。我在家看書。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài xuéxiào, bú zài jiā. Wǒ zài jiā kànshū.
examples.english: He is at school, not at home. I am at home reading.

examples.chinese: 我在學校，你要來這裡嗎？
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zài xuéxiào, nǐ yào lái zhèlǐ ma?
examples.english: I am at the school. Do you want to come here? (Are you coming?)

examples.chinese: 我跟同學常常一起在學校打網球。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gēn tóngxué chángcháng yìqǐ zài xuéxiào dǎ wǎngqiú.
examples.english: My classmates and I often play tennis together at the school.

examples.chinese: 我每個週末去學校打籃球。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ měi ge zhōumò qù xuéxiào dǎ lánqiú.
examples.english: I go to school to play basketball every weekend.

examples.chinese: 我每個星期都去學校跑步。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ měi ge xīngqí dōu qù xuéxiào pǎobù.
examples.english: I go to school to run every week.

examples.chinese: 我們學校旁邊有一家電影院。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen xuéxiào pángbiān yǒu yì jiā diànyǐngyuàn.
examples.english: There is a movie theater next to our school.

examples.chinese: 我每天早上七點去學校運動。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ měi tiān zǎoshang qī diǎn qù xuéxiào yùndòng.
examples.english: I go to school to exercise at 7:00 every morning.

examples.chinese: 前天下午我在學校的圖書館看書。
examples.pinyin: Qiántiān xiàwǔ wǒ zài xuéxiào de túshūguǎn kànshū.
examples.english: I read at the school library in the afternoon of the day before yesterday.

examples.chinese: 今天下午學校有籃球比賽，我們去看吧！
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān xiàwǔ xuéxiào yǒu lánqiú bǐsài, wǒmen qù kàn ba!
examples.english: There is a basketball game at school this afternoon. Let’s go watch it!

examples.chinese: 我每天早上八點半到學校。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ měitiān zǎoshang bā diǎn bàn dào xuéxiào.
examples.english: I arrive at school at 8:30 every morning.

examples.chinese: 他要從他家走路去學校。
examples.pinyin: Tā yào cóng tā jiā zǒulù qù xuéxiào.
examples.english: He wants to walk from his home to school.

examples.chinese: 學校附近有很多飲料店。
examples.pinyin: Xuéxiào fùjìn yǒu hěn duō yǐnliào diàn.
examples.english: There are many beverage shops near the school.

examples.chinese: 學校的圖書館早上八點開，晚上九點關。
examples.pinyin: Xuéxiào de túshūguǎn zǎoshang bā diǎn kāi, wǎnshang jiǔ diǎn guān.
examples.english: The school library opens at 8 a.m. and closes at 9 p.m.

examples.chinese: 明天有書法課，我要帶毛筆去學校。
examples.pinyin: Míngtiān yǒu shūfǎ kè, wǒ yào dài máobǐ qù xuéxiào.
examples.english: Tomorrow there is calligraphy class; I need to bring a brush to school.

examples.chinese: A:聽說你弟弟生病了，他現在怎麼樣？ B:他好了，明天可以去學校了。
examples.pinyin: A: Tīngshuō nǐ dìdi shēngbìng le, tā xiànzài zěnmeyàng? B: Tā hǎo le, míngtiān kěyǐ qù xuéxiào le.
examples.english: A: I heard your younger brother got sick; how is he now? B: He has gotten well; he can go to school tomorrow.

examples.chinese: 你要參加學校的游泳比賽嗎？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ yào cānjiā xuéxiào de yóuyǒng bǐsài ma?
examples.english: Are you going to participate in the school's swimming competition?

examples.chinese: 他的父母都在學校當老師。
examples.pinyin: Tā de fùmǔ dōu zài xuéxiào dāng lǎoshī.
examples.english: His parents both work as teachers at a school.

examples.chinese: 我剛剛在學校附近看到中明。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gānggāng zài xuéxiào fùjìn kàndào Zhōngmíng.
examples.english: I just now saw Zhongming near the school.

examples.chinese: 學校的網站上有很多學生寫的文章。
examples.pinyin: Xuéxiào de wǎngzhàn shàng yǒu hěn duō xuéshēng xiě de wénzhāng.
examples.english: On the school's website there are many articles written by students.

examples.chinese: 我明天早上十點會在學校門口等你。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ míngtiān zǎoshang shí diǎn huì zài xuéxiào ménkǒu děng nǐ.
examples.english: I will wait for you at the school gate at ten o'clock tomorrow morning.

examples.chinese: 明天晚上學校有一個新年晚會，你會去參加嗎？
examples.pinyin: Míngtiān wǎnshang xuéxiào yǒu yī gè xīnnián wǎnhuì, nǐ huì qù cānjiā ma?
examples.english: Tomorrow evening the school has a New Year evening event, will you go to participate?

examples.chinese: 他住的那棟大樓附近有學校，也有餐廳。
examples.pinyin: Tā zhù de nà dòng dàlóu fùjìn yǒu xuéxiào, yě yǒu cāntīng.
examples.english: Near the building where he lives there is a school, and also a restaurant.

examples.chinese: 大家都歡迎新老師到我們學校來。
examples.pinyin: Dàjiā dōu huānyíng xīn lǎoshī dào wǒmen xuéxiào lái.
examples.english: Everyone welcomes the new teacher to come to our school.

examples.chinese: 華人用十二生肖代表每一年。他常常代表學校去參加游泳比賽，所以在學校非常有名。
examples.pinyin: Huárén yòng shí'èr shēngxiào dàibiǎo měi yì nián. Tā chángcháng dàibiǎo xuéxiào qù cānjiā yóuyǒng bǐsài, suǒyǐ zài xuéxiào fēicháng yǒumíng.
examples.english: Chinese people use the twelve zodiac signs to represent each year. He often represents the school to participate in swimming competitions, so he is very famous at school.

examples.chinese: A:中明，請問學校圖書館幾點關？ B:你不知道啊？圖書館晚上九點關 。
examples.pinyin: A: Zhōngmíng, qǐngwèn xuéxiào túshūguǎn jǐ diǎn guān? B: Nǐ bù zhīdào a? Túshūguǎn wǎnshàng jiǔ diǎn guān.
examples.english: A: Zhongming, may I ask what time the school library closes? B: You don't know? The library closes at 9 p.m.

examples.chinese: 他手裡拿著禮物，在學校門口等著女朋友。
examples.pinyin: Tā shǒu lǐ názhe lǐwù, zài xuéxiào ménkǒu děngzhe nǚpéngyǒu.
examples.english: He is holding a gift in his hand and is waiting for his girlfriend at the school entrance.

examples.chinese: A:從學校到博物館去，應該往哪個方向走？ B:我看過地圖，應該往南走。
examples.pinyin: A: Cóng xuéxiào dào bówùguǎn qù, yīnggāi wǎng nǎge fāngxiàng zǒu? B: Wǒ kànguo dìtú, yīnggāi wǎng nán zǒu.
examples.english: A: From the school to the museum, which direction should we go? B: I've looked at the map; we should go south.

examples.chinese: 謝先生是從很有名的學校畢業的，但是聽說因為吃不了苦，什麼工作都做得不久。
examples.pinyin: Xiè xiānsheng shì cóng hěn yǒumíng de xuéxiào bìyè de, dànshì tīngshuō yīnwèi chī bùliǎo kǔ, shénme gōngzuò dōu zuò de bùjiǔ.
examples.english: Mr. Xie graduated from a very famous school, but I heard that because he can't endure hardship, he doesn't last long at any job.

examples.chinese: 我們學校的禮堂看起來空間不大，其實坐得下一千人。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen xuéxiào de lǐtáng kàn qǐlái kōngjiān bú dà, qíshí zuò de xià yì qiān rén.
examples.english: Our school's auditorium looks like it doesn't have much space, but actually it can seat a thousand people.

examples.chinese: 那所雙語學校強調，除了中文課以外，其他的課程都是用英文上的。
examples.pinyin: Nà suǒ shuāngyǔ xuéxiào qiángdiào, chúle Zhōngwén kè yǐwài, qítā de kèchéng dōu shì yòng Yīngwén shàng de.
examples.english: That bilingual school emphasizes that, except for Chinese classes, all other courses are taught in English.

examples.chinese: 昨天晚上突然發生強烈地震，學校旁的那座橋塌了，還好沒人受傷。
examples.pinyin: Zuótiān wǎnshàng tūrán fāshēng qiángliè dìzhèn, xuéxiào páng de nà zuò qiáo tā le, hái hǎo méi rén shòushāng.
examples.english: Last night a strong earthquake suddenly occurred; the bridge beside the school collapsed, but fortunately no one was injured.

examples.chinese: 因為水災的關係，許多學校沒辦法正常上課，甚至連便利商店都關了。
examples.pinyin: Yīnwèi shuǐzāi de guānxi, xǔduō xuéxiào méi bànfǎ zhèngcháng shàngkè, shènzhì lián biànlì shāngdiàn dōu guān le.
examples.english: Because of the flood, many schools cannot have classes normally; even convenience stores have closed.

examples.chinese: 許多青少年為了考上好學校，不得不犧牲假日去補習。
examples.pinyin: Xǔduō qīngshàonián wèile kǎo shàng hǎo xuéxiào, bùdébù xīshēng jiàrì qù bǔxí.
examples.english: Many teenagers, in order to get into a good school, have no choice but to sacrifice their holidays to go to cram school.

examples.chinese: 為了偏僻地區孩子的教育，有十幾位老師願意上山下海，到山上、海邊的學校教書。
examples.pinyin: Wèile piānpì dìqū háizi de jiàoyù, yǒu shí jǐ wèi lǎoshī yuànyì shàngshānxiàhǎi, dào shānshàng, hǎibiān de xuéxiào jiāoshū.
examples.english: For the education of children in remote areas, more than ten teachers are willing to go everywhere, to schools in the mountains and by the sea, to teach.

examples.chinese: 今天藝術系的學生要在學校的禮堂，演出跟十二生肖有關的故事。 那名演員很厲害，在那部電影裡一個人演出三個角色。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān yìshù xì de xuéshēng yào zài xuéxiào de lǐtáng, yǎnchū gēn shí'èr shēngxiào yǒuguān de gùshì. Nà míng yǎnyuán hěn lìhài, zài nà bù diànyǐng lǐ yīgè rén yǎnchū sān gè juésè.
examples.english: Today the art department students are going to perform a story related to the twelve zodiac signs in the school auditorium. That actor is very impressive; in that movie, he performed three roles by himself.

examples.chinese: 住在學校宿舍有一些限制，比如說晚上十點前必須回到宿舍。
examples.pinyin: Zhù zài xuéxiào sùshè yǒu yīxiē xiànzhì, bǐrú shuō wǎnshang shí diǎn qián bìxū huídào sùshè.
examples.english: Living in the school dormitory has some restrictions, for example, you must return to the dormitory before ten o'clock at night.

examples.chinese: 如果你能掌握老師教學的重要內容，這次的測驗就一定能得到高分。為了測驗出學生的華語程度，學校希望學生參加華語文能力測驗。
examples.pinyin: Rúguǒ nǐ néng zhǎngwò lǎoshī jiàoxué de zhòngyào nèiróng, zhè cì de cèyàn jiù yídìng néng dédào gāo fēn. Wèile cèyàn chū xuéshēng de Huáyǔ chéngdù, xuéxiào xīwàng xuéshēng cānjiā Huáyǔwén nénglì cèyàn.
examples.english: If you can grasp the important content of the teacher’s teaching, you will definitely get a high score on this test. In order to test students’ Chinese proficiency, the school hopes students will take the Chinese proficiency test.

examples.chinese: 有一些家長對現在的升學制度不滿，認為學校不應該逼孩子寫那麼多測驗題目。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu yìxiē jiāzhǎng duì xiànzài de shēngxué zhìdù bùmǎn, rènwéi xuéxiào bù yīnggāi bī háizi xiě nàme duō cèyàn tímù.
examples.english: Some parents are dissatisfied with the current school advancement system and think that schools should not force children to write so many test questions.

examples.chinese: 為了提供學生良好的學習環境，學校改善了教室的設備，網路的速度也變快了。
examples.pinyin: Wèile tígōng xuéshēng liánghǎo de xuéxí huánjìng, xuéxiào gǎishàn le jiàoshì de shèbèi, wǎnglù de sùdù yě biàn kuài le.
examples.english: In order to provide students with a good learning environment, the school improved the classroom equipment, and the internet speed also became faster.

examples.chinese: 學生與校長當面對話，希望學校改善教學設備和校園餐廳的服務品質。聽到老闆跟經理的對話，我才知道公司新產品的銷售成績不理想。
examples.pinyin: Xuéshēng yǔ xiàozhǎng dāngmiàn duìhuà, xīwàng xuéxiào gǎishàn jiàoxué shèbèi hé xiàoyuán cāntīng de fúwù pǐnzhí. Tīngdào lǎobǎn gēn jīnglǐ de duìhuà, wǒ cái zhīdào gōngsī xīn chǎnpǐn de xiāoshòu chéngjì bù lǐxiǎng.
examples.english: Students had a face-to-face dialogue with the principal, hoping the school would improve teaching equipment and the service quality of the campus cafeteria. Only after hearing the dialogue between the boss and the manager did I realize that the sales performance of the company's new product was not ideal.

examples.chinese: 雖然藍先生是大學的校長，可是他很謙虛，經常向同事請教管理學校的方法。
examples.pinyin: Suīrán Lán xiānsheng shì dàxué de xiàozhǎng, kěshì tā hěn qiānxū, jīngcháng xiàng tóngshì qǐngjiào guǎnlǐ xuéxiào de fāngfǎ.
examples.english: Although Mr. Lan is a university president, he is very modest and often asks colleagues for advice on methods for managing the school.

examples.chinese: 學校蓋了一棟活動中心，學生又多了一個交流、休閒的好場所了。
examples.pinyin: Xuéxiào gài le yī dòng huódòng zhōngxīn, xuéshēng yòu duō le yī gè jiāoliú, xiūxián de hǎo chǎngsuǒ le.
examples.english: The school has built an activity center; the students now have one more good place for interaction and leisure.

examples.chinese: 今天上午學校附近發生了車禍，經過警察處理後，現在交通已恢復正常。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān shàngwǔ xuéxiào fùjìn fāshēng le chēhuò, jīngguò jǐngchá chǔlǐ hòu, xiànzài jiāotōng yǐ huīfù zhèngcháng.
examples.english: This morning a car accident occurred near the school. After the police handled it, traffic has now returned to normal.

examples.chinese: 因為學校缺乏經費，宿舍的電腦設備暫時沒辦法改善。
examples.pinyin: Yīnwèi xuéxiào quēfá jīngfèi, sùshè de diànnǎo shèbèi zànshí méi bànfǎ gǎishàn.
examples.english: Because the school lacks funds, the computer equipment in the dormitory cannot be improved for the time being.

examples.chinese: 聽說那家飯店不遠，我想我們可以從學校走路去。
examples.pinyin: Tīngshuō nà jiā fàndiàn bù yuǎn, wǒ xiǎng wǒmen kěyǐ cóng xuéxiào zǒulù qù.
examples.english: I heard that the hotel is not far; I think we can go there from the school on foot.

examples.chinese: 我平常坐紅線去學校上課，週末也坐捷運去運動、看電影。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ píngcháng zuò hóng xiàn qù xuéxiào shàngkè, zhōumò yě zuò jiéyùn qù yùndòng, kàn diànyǐng.
examples.english: I usually go to school by the red one. On weekends I take it to exercise or see a movie as well.

examples.chinese: 對啊！聽說我們學校感冒、發燒的學生很多。
examples.pinyin: Duì a! Tīngshuō wǒmen xuéxiào gǎnmào, fāshāo de xuéshēng hěn duō.
examples.english: Right! I heard that many students from my school have a cold and fever.

examples.chinese: 他說他會去看醫生，請我們不要擔心，如果他好了，就會來學校上課。
examples.pinyin: Tā shuō tā huì qù kàn yīshēng, qǐng wǒmen bú yào dānxīn, rúguǒ tā hǎo le, jiù huì lái xuéxiào shàngkè.
examples.english: He said he will go see a doctor and he does not want to worry us. If he feels better, he will come to school.

examples.chinese: 我們都希望他明天能回學校上課。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen dōu xīwàng tā míngtiān néng huí xuéxiào shàngkè.
examples.english: We all hope he can come back to school tomorrow.

examples.chinese: 我妹妹跑得很慢。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ mèimei pǎo de hěn màn.
examples.english: My younger sister runs very slowly.

examples.chinese: 我不喜歡跑步，我跑步跑得很慢。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bù xǐhuān pǎobù, wǒ pǎobù pǎo de hěn màn.
examples.english: I do not like to run; I run slowly.

examples.chinese: 外國學生一開始學寫漢字的速度比較慢，只要多練習就能越寫越快了。
examples.pinyin: Wàiguó xuéshēng yī kāishǐ xué xiě Hànzì de sùdù bǐjiào màn, zhǐyào duō liànxí jiù néng yuè xiě yuè kuài le.
examples.english: Foreign students' speed at writing Chinese characters is relatively slow at first; as long as they practice more, they will be able to write faster and faster.

examples.chinese: 購物時我喜歡一個人慢慢看，不太喜歡店員一直向我推銷。
examples.pinyin: Gòuwù shí wǒ xǐhuān yí ge rén mànmàn kàn, bú tài xǐhuān diànyuán yìzhí xiàng wǒ tuīxiāo.
examples.english: When shopping, I like to look around slowly by myself; I don't really like salesclerks constantly trying to sell to me.

examples.chinese: 有一些病人不肯乖乖吃藥，護理師得有耐心，慢慢地跟他們講道理。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu yìxiē bìngrén bù kěn guāiguāi chī yào, hùlǐshī děi yǒu nàixīn, mànman de gēn tāmen jiǎng dàolǐ.
examples.english: Some patients refuse to take their medicine obediently, so nurses must have patience and slowly reason with them.

examples.chinese: 記者說參加這次慢跑活動的人數已經超過了一百人，可是我數來數去只有五十幾個。
examples.pinyin: Jìzhě shuō cānjiā zhè cì mànpǎo huódòng de rénshù yǐjīng chāoguò le yìbǎi rén, kěshì wǒ shǔ lái shǔ qù zhǐyǒu wǔshí jǐ ge.
examples.english: The reporter said the number of people participating in this jogging event has already exceeded one hundred, but I counted and counted and there were only fifty-some.

examples.chinese: 對華人來說，把書念好才有美好的未來，這個傳統觀念在臺灣已經慢慢改變了。
examples.pinyin: Duì Huárén lái shuō, bǎ shū niàn hǎo cái yǒu měihǎo de wèilái, zhège chuántǒng guānniàn zài Táiwān yǐjīng mànman gǎibiàn le.
examples.english: For Chinese people, only by studying well can one have a beautiful future; this traditional concept has already gradually changed in Taiwan.

examples.chinese: 許多國家因為工業進步得太快，反而使得農業慢慢不被重視了。
examples.pinyin: Xǔduō guójiā yīnwèi gōngyè jìnbù de tài kuài, fǎn'ér shǐde nóngyè mànmàn bù bèi zhòngshì le.
examples.english: Because industry in many countries progressed too quickly, it instead made agriculture gradually not be valued.

items.wordHook: a 忄(heart) holds a 曼(long), weary wait in → so 慢(slowly).

examples.chinese: 這幾盤菜都是我媽媽做的。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jǐ pán cài dōu shì wǒ māma zuò de.
examples.english: These few plates of dishes are all made by my mom.

examples.chinese: 這幾盤菜都是我媽媽做的。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jǐ pán cài dōu shì wǒ māma zuò de.
examples.english: These few plates of dishes are all made by my mom.

examples.chinese: A:我們要點幾盤菜？ B:今天是你的生日，我們多點幾盤吧。
examples.pinyin: A: Wǒmen yào diǎn jǐ pán cài? B: Jīntiān shì nǐ de shēngrì, wǒmen duō diǎn jǐ pán ba.
examples.english: A: How many dishes shall we order? B: Today is your birthday; let's order a few more dishes.

examples.chinese: 在這家餐廳吃飯，只要滿兩千塊，就送一盤水果。那個杯子裡裝滿了水。
examples.pinyin: Zài zhè jiā cāntīng chīfàn, zhǐyào mǎn liǎngqiān kuài, jiù sòng yī pán shuǐguǒ. Nàge bēizi lǐ zhuāng mǎn le shuǐ.
examples.english: At this restaurant, as long as you reach 2,000 dollars, they give you a plate of fruit. That cup is full of water.

examples.chinese: 你說你昨天吃了五盤芒果冰，太誇張了吧！
examples.pinyin: Nǐ shuō nǐ zuótiān chīle wǔ pán mángguǒ bīng, tài kuāzhāng le ba!
examples.english: You say you ate five plates of mango shaved ice yesterday—that's too exaggerated!

examples.chinese: 在這家餐廳吃飯，要是滿兩千元，老闆就免費招待一盤炒青菜。
examples.pinyin: Zài zhè jiā cāntīng chīfàn, yàoshi mǎn liǎngqiān yuán, lǎobǎn jiù miǎnfèi zhāodài yī pán chǎo qīngcài.
examples.english: If you spend at least two thousand dollars at this restaurant, the owner will treat you to a free plate of stir-fried greens.

examples.chinese: 要是你覺得這盤菜的味道太淡了，可以加一點醬料。
examples.pinyin: Yàoshi nǐ juéde zhè pán cài de wèidào tài dàn le, kěyǐ jiā yìdiǎn jiàngliào.
examples.english: If you feel this dish's flavor is too light, you can add a little sauce.

examples.chinese: 打破你們的碗盤是我的錯，我會對自己的行為負責，付你們這個費用。
examples.pinyin: Dǎpò nǐmen de wǎnpán shì wǒ de cuò, wǒ huì duì zìjǐ de xíngwéi fùzé, fù nǐmen zhège fèiyòng.
examples.english: Breaking your dishes was my fault; I will take responsibility for my behavior and pay you this fee.

examples.chinese: 那家餐廳的服務生很厲害，一隻手能端好幾個盤子。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā cāntīng de fúwùshēng hěn lìhài, yī zhī shǒu néng duān hǎo jǐ gè pánzi.
examples.english: The waiter at that restaurant is very impressive; he can hold several plates level with one hand.

examples.chinese: 中國人看傳統戲劇時都喜歡準備一盤瓜子，邊吃邊欣賞。
examples.pinyin: Zhōngguórén kàn chuántǒng xìjù shí dōu xǐhuān zhǔnbèi yī pán guāzǐ, biān chī biān xīnshǎng.
examples.english: When Chinese people watch traditional opera, they all like to prepare a plate of melon seeds and enjoy them while watching.

examples.chinese: 這一盤棋你下得真好，你一定花了很多工夫研究。
examples.pinyin: Zhè yì pán qí nǐ xià de zhēn hǎo, nǐ yídìng huā le hěn duō gōngfu yánjiū.
examples.english: You played this game of chess really well; you must have spent a lot of effort studying.

examples.chinese: 這部電腦的鍵盤有幾個鍵壞了，我得找人修理它。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bù diànnǎo de jiànpán yǒu jǐ ge jiàn huài le, wǒ děi zhǎo rén xiūlǐ tā.
examples.english: Several keys on this computer's keyboard are broken; I need to find someone to repair it.

examples.chinese: 那家公司的鍵盤常出問題，我再傻也不會跟他們購買。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā gōngsī de jiànpán cháng chū wèntí, wǒ zài shǎ yě bú huì gēn tāmen gòumǎi.
examples.english: That company's keyboards often have problems; no matter how foolish I am, I wouldn't buy from them.

examples.chinese: 我們到小張家時，他端了一盤切好的水果來招待我們。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen dào Xiǎo Zhāng jiā shí, tā duān le yī pán qiē hǎo de shuǐguǒ lái zhāodài wǒmen.
examples.english: When we arrived at Little Zhang's house, he brought out a plate of cut fruit to treat us.

items.wordHook: a 般(sort) tray of 皿(dish) plates rests on the table → one wide 盤(plate).

examples.chinese: 他習慣睡覺以前聽一點兒音樂。
examples.pinyin: Tā xíguàn shuìjiào yǐqián tīng yīdiǎnr yīnyuè.
examples.english: He is used to listening to a little music before sleeping.

examples.chinese: 張先生不但飲食習慣很好，而且每天運動，所以身體很健康。
examples.pinyin: Zhāng xiānsheng bùdàn yǐnshí xíguàn hěn hǎo, érqiě měitiān yùndòng, suǒyǐ shēntǐ hěn jiànkāng.
examples.english: Mr. Zhang not only has very good eating habits, but also exercises every day, so he is very healthy.

examples.chinese: 每個民族都有自己特殊的風俗習慣，有時候外國人不容易了解。
examples.pinyin: Měi ge mínzú dōu yǒu zìjǐ tèshū de fēngsú xíguàn, yǒu shíhou wàiguó rén bù róngyì liǎojiě.
examples.english: Every ethnic group has its own special customs and habits, which sometimes foreigners find hard to understand.

examples.chinese: 我室友的生活習慣很差，我已經忍耐他很久了，真希望他馬上搬走。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ shìyǒu de shēnghuó xíguàn hěn chà, wǒ yǐjīng rěnnài tā hěn jiǔ le, zhēn xīwàng tā mǎshàng bān zǒu.
examples.english: My roommate's living habits are very bad; I have tolerated him for a long time, and I really hope he moves out immediately.

examples.chinese: 現在大家都習慣用手機照相，一般的相機已經越來越少人使用了。
examples.pinyin: Xiànzài dàjiā dōu xíguàn yòng shǒujī zhàoxiàng, yìbān de xiàngjī yǐjīng yuèláiyuè shǎo rén shǐyòng le.
examples.english: Nowadays everyone is used to using their cell phones to take pictures; fewer and fewer people use regular cameras.

examples.chinese: 室友老是把髒襪子扔在地上，希望他能把這個壞習慣改掉。
examples.pinyin: Shìyǒu lǎo shì bǎ zāng wàzi rēng zài dìshang, xīwàng tā néng bǎ zhège huài xíguàn gǎi diào.
examples.english: My roommate always throws dirty socks on the floor; I hope he can change this bad habit.

examples.chinese: 何小姐習慣去傳統市場買水果，而且都跟同一個攤販買。
examples.pinyin: Hé xiǎojiě xíguàn qù chuántǒng shìchǎng mǎi shuǐguǒ, érqiě dōu gēn tóng yí ge tānfàn mǎi.
examples.english: Miss He is used to buying fruit at the traditional market, and she always buys from the same street vendor.

examples.chinese: 照華人的傳統習慣，女人生完孩子就要坐月子，一直在家休息到孩子滿月。
examples.pinyin: Zhào Huárén de chuántǒng xíguàn, nǚrén shēng wán háizi jiù yào zuòyuèzi, yīzhí zài jiā xiūxi dào háizi mǎnyuè.
examples.english: According to Chinese tradition, after a woman gives birth, she must practice confinement, resting at home until the baby is one month old.

examples.chinese: 我記得第一次出國讀書時，因為不習慣和家人分開，常常半夜哭著打電話回家。那對情侶因為不了解而在一起，沒想到最後因為了解而分開。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jìde dì yī cì chūguó dúshū shí, yīnwèi bù xíguàn hé jiārén fēnkāi, chángcháng bànyè kūzhe dǎ diànhuà huí jiā. Nà duì qínglǚ yīnwèi bù liǎojiě ér zài yīqǐ, méi xiǎngdào zuìhòu yīnwèi liǎojiě ér fēnkāi.
examples.english: I remember when I first went abroad to study, because I wasn't used to being separated from my family, I often cried on the phone at midnight. That couple got together because they didn't understand each other, but unexpectedly in the end they separated because they understood each other.

examples.chinese: 我跟弟弟是雙胞胎，很多人都以為我是他，這樣的誤會我早就習慣了。A:何小姐只是我的鄰居，不是我的女朋友，大家都誤會了。 B:你對她很體貼，不但常送她上班，還常陪她逛街，大家對你們有誤會也是正常的。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gēn dìdi shì shuāngbāotāi, hěn duō rén dōu yǐwéi wǒ shì tā, zhèyàng de wùhuì wǒ zǎo jiù xíguàn le. A: Hé xiǎojiě zhǐshì wǒ de línjū, bùshì wǒ de nǚpéngyǒu, dàjiā dōu wùhuì le. B: Nǐ duì tā hěn tǐtiē, bùdàn cháng sòng tā shàngbān, hái cháng péi tā guàngjiē, dàjiā duì nǐmen yǒu wùhuì yě shì zhèngcháng de.
examples.english: My younger brother and I are twins; many people think I am him, and I've long been used to this kind of misunderstanding. A: Miss He is just my neighbor, not my girlfriend; everyone has misunderstood. B: You are very considerate to her; not only do you often take her to work, but you also often accompany her shopping. It's normal for everyone to have a misunderstanding about you two.

examples.chinese: 強烈颱風快來了，救災中心對民眾發出警告，為了自己的生命安全，絕對別去海邊。小游經常喝了酒還開車回家，太太警告他如果不改掉這個壞習慣，就要跟他離婚。
examples.pinyin: Qiángliè táifēng kuài lái le, jiùzāi zhōngxīn duì mínzhòng fāchū jǐnggào, wèile zìjǐ de shēngmìng ānquán, juéduì bié qù hǎibiān. Xiǎo Yóu jīngcháng hē le jiǔ hái kāichē huí jiā, tàitai jǐnggào tā rúguǒ bù gǎidiào zhège huài xíguàn, jiù yào gēn tā líhūn.
examples.english: A strong typhoon is coming soon; the disaster relief center issued a warning to the public: for your own safety, absolutely do not go to the beach. Xiao You often drives home after drinking; his wife warned him that if he doesn't change this bad habit, she will divorce him.

examples.chinese: 簡老闆因為生意的關係，經常接觸越南人，相當了解兩國之間工作習慣的差異。
examples.pinyin: Jiǎn lǎobǎn yīnwèi shēngyì de guānxì, jīngcháng jiēchù Yuènánrén, xiāngdāng liǎojiě liǎng guó zhījiān gōngzuò xíguàn de chāyì.
examples.english: Boss Jian, because of business, frequently contacts Vietnamese people and quite understands the differences in working habits between the two countries.

examples.chinese: 何先生早就習慣了單身生活，一點都不想結婚。
examples.pinyin: Hé xiānsheng zǎo jiù xíguàn le dānshēn shēnghuó, yīdiǎn dōu bù xiǎng jiéhūn.
examples.english: Mr. He has long been accustomed to single life and doesn't want to get married at all.

examples.chinese: 想要讓身體健康，得先注意飲食，少吃太油、太鹹的食物；其次要培養每天運動的好習慣。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎng yào ràng shēntǐ jiànkāng, děi xiān zhùyì yǐnshí, shǎo chī tài yóu, tài xián de shíwù; qícì yào péiyǎng měitiān yùndòng de hǎo xíguàn.
examples.english: If you want to be healthy, you must first pay attention to your diet and eat less greasy and salty food; secondly, you need to cultivate the good habit of exercising every day.

examples.chinese: 中國南北方的飲食習慣有一些差異，南方人多吃米飯，北方人多吃餃子、饅頭等麵食。
examples.pinyin: Zhōngguó nánběifāng de yǐnshí xíguàn yǒu yīxiē chāyì, nánfāng rén duō chī mǐfàn, běifāng rén duō chī jiǎozi, mántou děng miànshí.
examples.english: There are some differences in eating habits between northern and southern China: southerners eat more cooked rice, while northerners eat more dumplings, steamed buns, and other wheat-based foods.

examples.chinese: 我習慣來這家銀行存款，因為這裡的員工都十分親切。你在辦一些國家的簽證時，他們得看你的銀行存款。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xíguàn lái zhè jiā yínháng cúnkuǎn, yīnwèi zhèlǐ de yuángōng dōu shífēn qīnqiè. Nǐ zài bàn yīxiē guójiā de qiānzhèng shí, tāmen děi kàn nǐ de yínháng cúnkuǎn.
examples.english: I am used to coming to this bank to deposit money, because the employees here are all very friendly. When you apply for visas for some countries, they need to see your bank savings.

examples.chinese: 送禮品給外國朋友前，最好先了解不同國家的送禮習慣。
examples.pinyin: Sòng lǐpǐn gěi wàiguó péngyǒu qián, zuìhǎo xiān liǎojiě bùtóng guójiā de sònglǐ xíguàn.
examples.english: Before giving gifts to foreign friends, it's best to first understand the gift-giving customs of different countries.

examples.chinese: 我爺爺習慣吃中式早餐，每天早上都是吃包子配豆漿。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yéye xíguàn chī zhōngshì zǎocān, měitiān zǎoshang dōu shì chī bāozi pèi dòujiāng.
examples.english: My grandfather is used to eating a Chinese-style breakfast; every morning he has steamed buns with soy milk.

examples.chinese: 我每天騎車上班前，總是習慣先檢查摩托車的輪子正不正常。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ měi tiān qí chē shàngbān qián, zǒngshì xíguàn xiān jiǎnchá mótuōchē de lúnzi zhèng bù zhèngcháng.
examples.english: Before I ride my bike to work every day, I always habitually first check whether the motorcycle's tires are normal.

examples.chinese: 自從他改變飲食習慣以後，就變得既健康又有活力。
examples.pinyin: Zìcóng tā gǎibiàn yǐnshí xíguàn yǐhòu, jiù biàn de jì jiànkāng yòu yǒu huólì.
examples.english: Ever since he changed his eating habits, he has become both healthy and full of vitality.

examples.chinese: 我跟他的個性、想法都合得來，就是飲食習慣合不來。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gēn tā de gèxìng, xiǎngfǎ dōu hé de lái, jiùshì yǐnshí xíguàn hé bù lái.
examples.english: He and I get along in personality and ideas, but it's just our eating habits that are incompatible.

examples.chinese: 奶奶養了幾隻雞，每天早上習慣抓兩把玉米餵牠們。
examples.pinyin: Nǎinai yǎngle jǐ zhī jī, měitiān zǎoshang xíguàn zhuā liǎng bǎ yùmǐ wèi tāmen.
examples.english: Grandma raises several chickens, and every morning she is used to grabbing two handfuls of corn to feed them.

examples.chinese: 有些女性懷孕時飲食習慣會有極大的改變，醫生說這是正常現象。
examples.pinyin: Yǒuxiē nǚxìng huáiyùn shí yǐnshí xíguàn huì yǒu jídà de gǎibiàn, yīshēng shuō zhè shì zhèngcháng xiànxiàng.
examples.english: Some women experience great changes in their eating habits when they become pregnant; doctors say this is a normal phenomenon.

examples.chinese: 我習慣把每一筆支出都記錄起來，提醒自己少花點兒錢。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xíguàn bǎ měi yì bǐ zhīchū dōu jìlù qǐlái, tíxǐng zìjǐ shǎo huā diǎnr qián.
examples.english: I am used to recording every expense, to remind myself to spend a little less money.

examples.chinese: 隨著電子產業發展，人們的生活習慣也受到很深的影響。
examples.pinyin: Suízhe diànzǐ chǎnyè fāzhǎn, rénmen de shēnghuó xíguàn yě shòudào hěn shēn de yǐngxiǎng.
examples.english: With the development of the electronics industry, people's living habits have also been deeply affected.

examples.chinese: 我在喝粥時習慣加一些芝麻進去，喝起來很香。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zài hē zhōu shí xíguàn jiā yīxiē zhīma jìnqù, hē qǐlái hěn xiāng.
examples.english: When I drink congee, I'm used to adding some sesame seeds; it tastes very fragrant.

examples.chinese: 世界各地的神話雖然不見得都真實，卻能讓人們多少了解一些古代的風俗習慣。
examples.pinyin: Shìjiè gèdì de shénhuà suīrán bú jiàndé dōu zhēnshí, què néng ràng rénmen duōshǎo liǎojiě yīxiē gǔdài de fēngsú xíguàn.
examples.english: Although myths from around the world are not necessarily all true, they can still let people understand some ancient customs and habits to some extent.

examples.chinese: 由於網路發達，現代人大都習慣上網購物。
examples.pinyin: Yóuyú wǎnglù fādá, xiàndài rén dàdōu xíguàn shàngwǎng gòuwù.
examples.english: Due to the development of the Internet, modern people for the most part are accustomed to shopping online.

examples.chinese: 我習慣在家裡放一盆花，讓室內有鮮花的香味。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xíguàn zài jiālǐ fàng yī pén huā, ràng shìnèi yǒu xiānhuā de xiāngwèi.
examples.english: I am used to placing a pot of flowers at home, so that the room has the fragrance of fresh flowers.

examples.chinese: 手機鬧鐘的音量及音樂聲，都可按照個人的使用習慣來調整。
examples.pinyin: Shǒujī nàozhōng de yīnliàng jí yīnyuè shēng, dōu kě ànzhào gèrén de shǐyòng xíguàn lái tiáozhěng.
examples.english: The volume of the mobile phone alarm and the sound of the music can both be adjusted according to personal usage habits.

examples.chinese: 醫生說，經常運動的人，比較不容易生病。
examples.pinyin: Yīshēng shuō, jīngcháng yùndòng de rén, bǐjiào bù róngyì shēngbìng.
examples.english: The doctor says that people who usually exercise are less likely to get sick.

examples.chinese: 那個店員經常對客人微笑，讓人覺得很親切。
examples.pinyin: Nàge diànyuán jīngcháng duì kèrén wēixiào, ràng rén juéde hěn qīnqiè.
examples.english: That clerk often smiles at customers, making people feel very friendly.

examples.chinese: 張先生常幫太太買菜、洗衣服， 要是比太太早下班，還會把晚餐做好，真體貼。我同學很體貼父母，經常煮飯、 做家事，幫了父母不少忙。
examples.pinyin: Zhāng xiānsheng cháng bāng tàitai mǎi cài, xǐ yīfu, yàoshi bǐ tàitai zǎo xiàbān, hái huì bǎ wǎncān zuò hǎo, zhēn tǐtiē. Wǒ tóngxué hěn tǐtiē fùmǔ, jīngcháng zhǔfàn, zuò jiāshì, bāng le fùmǔ bùshǎo máng.
examples.english: Mr. Zhang often helps his wife buy groceries and wash clothes; if he gets off work earlier than his wife, he also makes dinner—he is truly considerate. My classmate is very considerate of his parents; he often cooks and does housework, helping his parents a lot.

examples.chinese: 這個地區是個危險地帶，因為經常一下雨就有石頭掉下來，有時候連路都會塌了。
examples.pinyin: Zhège dìqū shì ge wēixiǎn dìdài, yīnwèi jīngcháng yí xià yǔ jiù yǒu shítou diào xiàlái, yǒu shíhou lián lù dōu huì tā le.
examples.english: This area is a dangerous zone, because whenever it rains, rocks often fall, and sometimes even the road collapses.

examples.chinese: 背包客為了解省交通費，經常搭別人的車到下一個地點。
examples.pinyin: Bèibāokè wèile jiéshěng jiāotōng fèi, jīngcháng dā biérén de chē dào xià yí ge dìdiǎn.
examples.english: In order to save on transportation costs, backpackers often hitch rides in other people's cars to the next place.

examples.chinese: 父母要經常陪孩子聊天、玩遊戲，給零用錢不能完全滿足孩子的需要。
examples.pinyin: Fùmǔ yào jīngcháng péi háizi liáotiān, wán yóuxì, gěi língyòngqián bù néng wánquán mǎnzú háizi de xūyào.
examples.english: Parents should often chat and play games with their children; giving pocket money cannot completely satisfy children's needs.

examples.chinese: 李先生經常咳嗽，可是他完全不在意。直到今天咳得說不出話來了，才肯去看醫生。
examples.pinyin: Lǐ xiānshēng jīngcháng késòu, kěshì tā wánquán bù zàiyì. Zhídào jīntiān ké de shuō bù chū huà lái le, cái kěn qù kàn yīshēng.
examples.english: Mr. Li often coughs, but he doesn't care at all. It was not until today, when he coughed so much that he couldn't speak, that he was willing to go see a doctor.

examples.chinese: 強烈颱風快來了，救災中心對民眾發出警告，為了自己的生命安全，絕對別去海邊。小游經常喝了酒還開車回家，太太警告他如果不改掉這個壞習慣，就要跟他離婚。
examples.pinyin: Qiángliè táifēng kuài lái le, jiùzāi zhōngxīn duì mínzhòng fāchū jǐnggào, wèile zìjǐ de shēngmìng ānquán, juéduì bié qù hǎibiān. Xiǎo Yóu jīngcháng hē le jiǔ hái kāichē huí jiā, tàitai jǐnggào tā rúguǒ bù gǎidiào zhège huài xíguàn, jiù yào gēn tā líhūn.
examples.english: A strong typhoon is coming soon; the disaster relief center issued a warning to the public: for your own safety, absolutely do not go to the beach. Xiao You often drives home after drinking; his wife warned him that if he doesn't change this bad habit, she will divorce him.

examples.chinese: 這個路口很危險，經常發生車禍。
examples.pinyin: Zhège lùkǒu hěn wēixiǎn, jīngcháng fāshēng chēhuò.
examples.english: This intersection is very dangerous; car accidents often happen here.

examples.chinese: 那個網路商店經常賣假貨，你可別上當。
examples.pinyin: Nàge wǎnglù shāngdiàn jīngcháng mài jiǎhuò, nǐ kě bié shàngdàng.
examples.english: That online store often sells fake goods; you'd better not be tricked.

examples.chinese: 簡老闆因為生意的關係，經常接觸越南人，相當了解兩國之間工作習慣的差異。
examples.pinyin: Jiǎn lǎobǎn yīnwèi shēngyì de guānxì, jīngcháng jiēchù Yuènánrén, xiāngdāng liǎojiě liǎng guó zhījiān gōngzuò xíguàn de chāyì.
examples.english: Boss Jian, because of business, frequently contacts Vietnamese people and quite understands the differences in working habits between the two countries.

examples.chinese: 雖然藍先生是大學的校長，可是他很謙虛，經常向同事請教管理學校的方法。
examples.pinyin: Suīrán Lán xiānsheng shì dàxué de xiàozhǎng, kěshì tā hěn qiānxū, jīngcháng xiàng tóngshì qǐngjiào guǎnlǐ xuéxiào de fāngfǎ.
examples.english: Although Mr. Lan is a university president, he is very modest and often asks colleagues for advice on methods for managing the school.

examples.chinese: 史教授為了讓更多人了解保護地球環境有多重要，經常到各地去演講。
examples.pinyin: Shǐ jiàoshòu wèi le ràng gèng duō rén liǎojiě bǎohù dìqiú huánjìng yǒu duō zhòngyào, jīngcháng dào gèdì qù yǎnjiǎng.
examples.english: In order to let more people understand how important it is to protect the Earth's environment, Professor Shi often goes to various places to give speeches.

examples.chinese: 歷史系的李教授最近經常接受記者的訪問，因此變得很有名。那名記者為了訪問總統外交、貿易等方面的問題，閱讀了許多相關的資料。
examples.pinyin: Lìshǐ xì de Lǐ jiàoshòu zuìjìn jīngcháng jiēshòu jìzhě de fǎngwèn, yīncǐ biàn de hěn yǒumíng. Nà míng jìzhě wèile fǎngwèn zǒngtǒng wàijiāo, màoyì děng fāngmiàn de wèntí, yuèdú le xǔduō xiāngguān de zīliào.
examples.english: Professor Li from the History Department has recently often been interviewed by reporters, and therefore has become very famous. That reporter, in order to interview the president about questions on diplomacy, trade, and other aspects, read a lot of related materials.

examples.chinese: 市中心有座正方形的廣場，民眾經常到那裡散步。

examples.english: In the city center there is a square plaza; people often go there for a walk.

examples.chinese: 吃了健康食品以後，還是得經常運動才能擁有好身材。
examples.pinyin: Chī le jiànkāng shípǐn yǐhòu, háishì děi jīngcháng yùndòng cái néng yōngyǒu hǎo shēncái.
examples.english: After eating health food, you still need to exercise regularly to have a good figure.

examples.chinese: 百貨公司經常辦活動及送贈品，都是為了鼓勵客人多消費。
examples.pinyin: Bǎihuò gōngsī jīngcháng bàn huódòng jí sòng zèngpǐn, dōu shì wèile gǔlì kèrén duō xiāofèi.
examples.english: Department stores often hold events and give away free gifts, all to encourage customers to spend more.

examples.chinese: 國內外的社會運動，經常都是因為人民的意見不被尊重而引起的。
examples.pinyin: Guónèi wài de shèhuì yùndòng, jīngcháng dōu shì yīnwèi rénmín de yìjiàn bù bèi zūnjìng ér yǐnqǐ de.
examples.english: Social movements at home and abroad are often caused because people's opinions are not respected.

examples.chinese: 對學生來說，經常失眠可能降低學習效率。
examples.pinyin: Duì xuéshēng lái shuō, jīngcháng shīmián kěnéng jiàngdī xuéxí xiàolǜ.
examples.english: For students, frequent insomnia may reduce learning efficiency.

examples.chinese: 她的外語能力不錯，因此公司經常派她到國外出差。
examples.pinyin: Tā de wàiyǔ nénglì bùcuò, yīncǐ gōngsī jīngcháng pài tā dào guówài chūchāi.
examples.english: Her foreign language ability is good, so the company often sends her abroad on business trips.

examples.chinese: 利用週末到安養院幫助老人，是很有意義的活動。

examples.english: Using the weekend to go to a nursing home to help the elderly is a very meaningful activity.

examples.chinese: 我喜歡週末跟家人聚在一起吃飯、聊天。愛心服務社把社員的愛心聚在一起，到安養院去幫助老人。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuān zhōumò gēn jiārén jù zài yīqǐ chīfàn, liáotiān. Àixīn fúwùshè bǎ shèyuán de àixīn jù zài yīqǐ, dào ānyǎngyuàn qù bāngzhù lǎorén.
examples.english: I like to gather with my family on weekends to eat and chat. The Love Service Club gathers the members' love together and goes to the nursing home to help the elderly.

examples.chinese: 愛心服務社社員去安養院陪老人過年，讓老人們感覺相當溫暖。
examples.pinyin: Àixīn fúwùshè shèyuán qù ānyǎngyuàn péi lǎorén guò nián, ràng lǎorénmen gǎnjué xiāngdāng wēnnuǎn.
examples.english: The members of the Love Service Club went to the nursing home to accompany the elderly through the New Year, making the elderly feel quite warm.

examples.chinese: 小陳很孝順，每個週末都去安養院陪父親聊天、散步，一點兒都不覺得辛苦。孝順父母的方法很多，最簡單的就是不讓他們擔心、生氣。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Chén hěn xiàoshùn, měi gè zhōumò dōu qù ānyǎngyuàn péi fùqīn liáotiān, sànbù, yīdiǎnr dōu bù juéde xīnkǔ. Xiàoshùn fùmǔ de fāngfǎ hěn duō, zuì jiǎndān de jiùshì bù ràng tāmen dānxīn, shēngqì.
examples.english: Xiao Chen is very filial; every weekend he goes to the nursing home to chat and take walks with his father, and doesn't feel the least bit tired. There are many ways to be filial to parents; the simplest is to not make them worry or get angry.

examples.chinese: 老師把安養院社團的社員分成兩個小組，第一組陪老人唱歌， 第二組陪老人玩遊戲。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī bǎ ānyǎngyuàn shètuán de shèyuán fēnchéng liǎng ge xiǎozǔ, dì-yī zǔ péi lǎorén chànggē, dì-èr zǔ péi lǎorén wán yóuxì.
